title: carbon.toml
description: Manifest for a carbon-native application. This file is the single source of truth for the manifest shape: the TypeScript loader in shared/logic/ts/src/config.ts and the Rust parser in shared/logic/core/src/config.rs are both checked against it by shared/tests/shared/config/conformance.test.ts. Change the schema first, then both parsers.

app.description: Identity and window shape of the application.

name.description: Machine name. Used for the binary name, the install directory and the update feed path.

version.description: Semantic version of the app. The updater compares releases with this.

display_name.description: Human-facing name shown in the title bar and installer.

dev_url.description: Dev-server URL used by `carbon dev` instead of the built bundle.

window.description: Initial window geometry. Consumed by the runtime, not the CLI.

capabilities.description: Capability grants. Every entry is a glob allow-list; an absent key means the capability is denied outright. Enforced by the runtime, never by the CLI.

runtime.description: Which backend executes the app, and which optional native features it links in.

backend.description: Renderer backend. Must be a directory under runtime/ with a native crate.

bytecode.description: Pre-compile the JS bundle to QuickJS bytecode + zstd at build time. Saves ~5-10 ms cold start and shrinks the shipped bundle, but for trivial bundles the compress/decompress overhead breaks even. Worth enabling above ~50 KB of source. Implemented by the mini backend only.

image.description: Link carbon/runtime/features/image and register the image host imports. Off by default so apps that never load an image pay zero binary cost for the decoders.

audio.description: Link carbon/host/audio and expose the Web Audio API. Off by default so no audio device is opened and there is no cold-start cost.

updater.description: Update client configuration. Signatures are verified against `pubkey` using ed25519 (see shared/signer).

pubkey.description: ed25519 public key, base64. Generate with `carbon signer generate`. NEVER put the private key in this file.

url.description: Base URL of the update feed.

crash_threshold.description: Consecutive startup crashes after an update before the runtime rolls back to the previous version.

plugins.description: Native plugin grants. Keys are plugin names; values are either `true` (load from the default location), a path string, or a table with explicit path and capability grants. Loading is driven by carbon/api/plugin_loader.rs; an absent or empty section makes the loader a no-op.
